SELECT 
  s.region,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) AS month,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) AS gross_sales_incl_vat
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2024-08-01'
  AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-30'
  AND s.store_id <> 999
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY s.region, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date)
ORDER BY s.region, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date)

-- Verify against rpt_daily_store_sales control total
SELECT 
  SUM(net_sales) * 1.24 AS net_to_gross_24pct,
  SUM(net_sales) AS net_sales_total,
  COUNT(*) as rows
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date >= '2024-08-01'
  AND business_date <= '2024-09-30'
  AND store_id <> 999

-- Check the structure of my query - does it have duplicates? Check for record count
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_lines,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) as distinct_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2024-08-01'
  AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-30'
  AND s.store_id <> 999
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'

-- Check my total gross vs net + implied VAT
SELECT 
  SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) as total_gross,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) - SUM(f.net_amount) as implied_vat
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2024-08-01'
  AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-30'
  AND s.store_id <> 999
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'

-- Check if the difference is due to web sales timing
-- Get web sales with their dispatch dates
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as web_lines_count,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) as web_gross
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2024-08-01'
  AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-30'
  AND s.store_id = 900

-- Check net_sales_before_returns from rpt_daily_store_sales
SELECT 
  SUM(net_sales_before_returns) as net_before_returns,
  COUNT(*) as rows
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date >= '2024-08-01'
  AND business_date <= '2024-09-30'
  AND store_id <> 999

SELECT 
  s.region,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) = 8 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS august_2024,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) = 9 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS september_2024
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2024-08-01'
  AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-30'
  AND s.store_id <> 999
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY s.region
ORDER BY s.region

-- Check impact of using dispatch date for web sales instead of order date
SELECT 
  s.region,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', f.sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) = 8 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS aug_dispatch,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', f.sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) = 9 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sep_dispatch
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id = 900
  AND f.sale_date >= '2024-08-01'
  AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-30'

-- Check impact of dispatch date vs order date for web sales
SELECT 
  'order_date' as method,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date >= '2024-08-01' AND f.sale_date <= '2024-08-31' THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS aug_gross,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date >= '2024-09-01' AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-30' THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sep_gross
FROM fact_sales_line f
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'dispatch_date' as method,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', wo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) = 8 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', wo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) = 9 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END)
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN fact_web_order wo ON wo.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB'

WITH sales_with_dates AS (
  -- Store sales with sale_date
  SELECT 
    s.region,
    f.sale_date as transaction_date,
    f.gross_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999
    AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
    AND f.sale_date >= '2024-08-01'
    AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-30'
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Web sales with dispatch_date
  SELECT 
    s.region,
    CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', wo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) as transaction_date,
    f.gross_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN fact_web_order wo ON wo.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999
    AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND f.channel_code = 'WB'
    AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', wo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) >= '2024-08-01'
    AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', wo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) <= '2024-09-30'
)
SELECT 
  region,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM transaction_date) = 8 THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS august_2024,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM transaction_date) = 9 THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS september_2024
FROM sales_with_dates
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region

-- Final verification: sum net and gross for control
WITH sales_with_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    f.net_amount,
    f.gross_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999
    AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
    AND f.sale_date >= '2024-08-01'
    AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-30'
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    f.net_amount,
    f.gross_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN fact_web_order wo ON wo.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999
    AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND f.channel_code = 'WB'
    AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', wo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) >= '2024-08-01'
    AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', wo.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) <= '2024-09-30'
)
SELECT 
  SUM(net_amount) as total_net,
  SUM(gross_amount) as total_gross,
  COUNT(*) as line_count
FROM sales_with_dates

  -- Store sales with sale_date
  SELECT 
    s.region,

    f.gross_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key

SELECT 
  region,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM transaction_date) = 8 THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS august_2024,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM transaction_date) = 9 THEN gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS september_2024
